# NVIDIA Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026
**Meeting date:** 17 November 2026 (same day as fiscal Q3 2027 results)
**Coverage window:** Approximately 16 October to 15 November 2026, with earlier items included only as context

---

## Executive Summary

NVIDIA's co-founder and chief executive, Jensen Huang, resigned with immediate effect on 12 November 2026, and the board appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO while she keeps her finance role ([NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition)). The company says operations, customer commitments and the product roadmap should continue without interruption ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). Media reports tie the departure to extramarital affair allegations, and some outlets describe further security and espionage-related claims that I could not verify from the material provided ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)).

The same month brought a $500 billion-plus compute financing initiative with six major asset managers and banks, a Vera Rubin ramp into full production, and a sharp share-price reaction. Today's meeting falls on the day results are released, which means the company's first public read on whether the leadership change affects guidance, receivables and deal commitments will arrive during or just before the meeting.

---

## 1. Context and Scope

NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) describes itself as "the world leader in AI and accelerated computing" ([NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition)). Its fiscal year ends in late January, so fiscal Q3 2027 covers late July to late October 2026 and the quarter ended on 25 October 2026 ([NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873)).

Two points about the meeting itself:

- **Disclosure timing.** Results are posted at about 1:20 p.m. PT, with CFO commentary in writing, and the 2 p.m. PT call's Q&A is limited to financial analysts and institutional investors ([NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873)). Any discussion before publication should avoid material non-public information. Questions should focus on matters already in the public domain.
- **Source quality.** Several sources in this briefing are secondary, aggregated, or AI-assisted. Where a claim rests on one of these, the report says so.

---

## 2. What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### 2.1 Leadership

| Change | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| CEO departure | Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO and board member, effective immediately. The board accepted the resignation on 11 November. | [NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition); [Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in) |
| Interim CEO | Colette Kress, EVP and CFO since September 2013, is interim CEO while keeping her CFO role until a permanent successor is named. | [NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition); [Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in) |
| Board chair | Harvey C. Jones was named the company's first-ever Chair of the Board. He has been a director since 1993 and is a former CEO and Executive Chairman of Synopsys. | [NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition); [Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in) |
| Succession search | The board is searching for a permanent CEO and will consider internal and external candidates. Reuters-sourced commentary names Kress, Ian Buck and Arm CEO Rene Haas as names under discussion. | [NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition); [Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress) |
| Board statements | Statements from the board and independent directors were issued on 8 and 10 November, before the resignation. Their titles are listed on the company newsroom. | [NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-partners-with-apollo-blackrock-blackstone-brookfield-goldman-sachs-and-kkr-to-establish-ai-compute-infrastructure-financing-platforms-to-mobilize-over-500-billion-of-third-party-capital) |

Kress has been cited by analysts and investors for her authority and her relationships with Wall Street ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)). Her tenure includes growth in annual revenue from $4.13 billion in fiscal 2014 to $215.9 billion in fiscal 2026 ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)).

### 2.2 Deals and Financing

On 12 November, NVIDIA announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish AI compute infrastructure financing platforms. The stated aim is to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital, subject to definitive agreements ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-partners-with-apollo-blackrock-blackstone-brookfield-goldman-sachs-and-kkr-to-establish-ai-compute-infrastructure-financing-platforms-to-mobilize-over-500-billion-of-third-party-capital)). Data Centre Magazine reports the same figure and the same condition ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)).

Two related items from the same period need careful reading:

- Network World reported on 11 August 2026 a $500 billion investment pool with six financial partners to help customers buy chips on credit ([Network World, 2026](https://www.networkworld.com/article/3562856/nvidia-latest-news-and-insights.html)). This is outside the 30-day window. Whether it is the same program as the November platforms is **not clear from the sources provided**, and the meeting should confirm the relationship.
- Tracxn lists the Hugging Face acquisition in September 2026 as NVIDIA's most recent acquisition. No acquisitions appear in the 30-day window in the provided material ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-nvidia/__Rwvr9cCWEygAYAiBEK0RuL1AbkKNw9sBGPqMEY6zVh4)).

### 2.3 Products and Partnerships

- **Vera Rubin.** The platform was ramping into full production, with racks running at CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). OpenAI's first gigawatt of NVIDIA systems was planned for the second half of 2026 on this platform ([OpenAI, 2025](https://openai.com/index/openai-nvidia-systems-partnership)).
- **Sovereign AI.** On 8 November, NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a collaboration on sovereign AI infrastructure using NVLink Fusion ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-partners-with-apollo-blackrock-blackstone-brookfield-goldman-sachs-and-kkr-to-establish-ai-compute-infrastructure-financing-platforms-to-mobilize-over-500-billion-of-third-party-capital)).
- **Ecosystem announcements in October.** Tracxn lists a Nutanix expansion, a Mercedes-Benz driving system, a robotaxi venture with Pony.ai and inDrive in Kazakhstan, and an expanded NVIDIA partnership with Meta on October 27 ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-nvidia/__Rwvr9cCWEygAYAiBEK0RuL1AbkKNw9sBGPqMEY6zVh4)). Tracxn also reports that OpenAI planned to purchase Google's AI chips, which is a competitive signal in the same listing ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-nvidia/__Rwvr9cCWEygAYAiBEK0RuL1AbkKNw9sBGPqMEY6zVh4)).

### 2.4 Market Reaction

NVIDIA shares fell more than 13% in early trading on 12 November ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). A later quote snapshot on Yahoo Finance, captured on 13 November, shows NVDA down 3.12% for that session, with the Nasdaq down 0.91% ([Kollmann, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-110116748.html)). These figures come from different points in the session and should not be combined.

Quantisnow, an AI-assisted service, states that NVDA closed higher the next session three times and lower twice after the five leadership changes it tracks since October 2025. It adds that these moves show timing only ([Quantisnow, 2026](https://quantisnow.com/insight/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition-6786728)). The sample is very small and the source is paywalled, so this should be treated as context, not evidence.

---

---

## 4. Assessment

**My view is that the leadership change is primarily a governance and concentration-of-responsibility event, not yet an operating shock.** The evidence for continuity is real: the company has reaffirmed its roadmap, the Vera Rubin ramp is under way across major clouds, and the board chair has publicly backed Kress ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). Nothing in the provided sources shows a change to guidance or a customer loss.

I consider three issues more decision-relevant than the CEO search itself.
